answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 952 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nebula. The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the haven queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. A farm of 159 pays that 171 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
